Connect an Epson printer over USB OTG, then tap the refresh button
Last successful status; the latest refresh failed

No answer on the first connection route, so another is being tried. This can take a few seconds, and should be quicker next time.
Resetting does not clean the pad
The counter is electronic; the pad is physical. Wash, replace or redirect the waste ink before resetting, or ink will eventually leak inside the printer.
No counter to reset on this model
This printer does not keep a waste ink counter the app can reset. Nothing is broken: neither the app nor the printer is at fault.
Status and ink levels are available. Waste counters are not read or reset until a verified profile is in the app. You can send a model request; it does not have to finish before these readings.
Head cleaning consumes ink and adds to the waste counter. This app cannot reset that counter on this printer, because it has no verified profile.
Power cleaning is not available without a verified profile. It uses more ink, and this app could not put the waste counter back.
No percentage: this model\'s counter limit is not published. The value above is the raw reading.
This model\'s counter limit is not published, so there is no target percentage. The reset writes the values published for this model, across every address it lists.
The values these addresses held before the write. Keep a copy so you can put them back if something goes wrong.

A backup is saved automatically before every write. Pick one to put those values back, or paste a backup you kept.

This writes back the values recorded before an earlier write. It raises the counters, which is the opposite of a reset. Use it only to undo one.

This printer uses a maintenance box

Waste ink goes into a removable maintenance box (ET-2980: T04D100), and the box records the level on its own chip. There is no counter in the printer for any app to reset over USB — when the box fills, it is replaced and confirmed with OK on the printer panel.
Your printer uses a maintenance box

The waste ink from head cleaning collects in a removable maintenance box (ET-2980: T04D100), not in pads inside the printer. The box carries its own chip that records how full it is, and the printer keeps no counter of its own — so no software, adjustment program, or USB utility can clear it. There is also no reset hidden in the printer Settings menu.

Official replacement (Epson): 1) Have a new box ready and make sure the printer is not printing. 2) Loosen the screw on the maintenance-box cover with a flat-head screwdriver and remove the cover. 3) Pull the used box straight out without tilting it. 4) Seal it in the bag supplied with the new box. 5) Insert the new box fully in the correct direction, refit the cover and tighten the screw. 6) Press OK on the LCD and follow the on-screen instructions. Do not touch the green chip, and do not reuse a box left out for over a week.

Third-party physical chip resetters for T04D1 exist, but they only clear the chip — they do not empty the ink — and they cannot run from this app over USB.

Head cleaning and the nozzle check still work on this printer. They are on the Maintenance page.
Where the waste ink count lives

Epson stores the waste ink count in one of two places.

Internal pad: the ink is absorbed by pads inside the printer and the fill level is kept in the printer's own memory. This is the case this app can reset.

Maintenance box: the ink collects in a box you can remove, and the box carries its own chip that records the fill level. The printer's memory holds no counter, so no software can clear it. The box is replaced, or its chip is reset with a dedicated tool.

To find out which one you have, check the printer's own status panel. If it reports a maintenance box, no reset utility can help.

If your printer uses an internal pad and you still see this, the model is simply missing from the app's database. That one is fixable, and we would like to hear about it.

Prints a nozzle check page. It uses a sheet of paper and a little ink, and it is the only way to tell whether a head cleaning is worth doing.

Opens the releases page in your browser. The app itself never goes online.
E-Pad Reset is free, has no ads and no account. If it saved you a service call, you can support its development.

The printer did not answer on any USB route. Try another cable or port, turn it off and on again, then retry.
The printer\'s USB connection could not be claimed. Another app may be using it (e.g. a print service); close any other printer apps and retry.
These counters share memory bytes with another counter, so they can only be reset together. Select all counters to proceed.
No waste counter was selected, so there is nothing to reset.
This model does not publish reset values for the selected counters, so there is nothing to write.
A target percentage cannot be written for this selection: the counters must publish a limit, fit in four bytes, and not share bytes with another counter.
This backup holds no address the connected printer uses, so there is nothing to write back.
Prepare a limited report locally, then review it and choose how to share it. The app does not connect to the Internet.

Support is not guaranteed. This draft includes only model fields, USB IDs and app/Android versions, not raw logs, serial numbers or EEPROM backups. Review anything you add. Nothing is sent automatically; another app or your browser handles external sharing under its own privacy policy.
Discord requires an account. Copy the reviewed report, open the community and ask where to post a model request. Opening the invite does not paste or publish it.
GitHub requires an account. Copy the reviewed report and paste it into the model request template. No diagnostic data is placed in the link.

Without a GitHub or Discord account, share through an app you already use with someone who can relay the request. There is no dedicated inbox configured. Choose the recipient yourself; opening the share sheet does not mean a maintainer received it.
No app could open this action. You can still copy the report and choose a destination yourself.
Waste ink counters have been updated. Restart the printer if required by the model.
The bytes read back at %1$s do not match the reset values sent. Some values may have changed. The backup is below; expected and read bytes are in the protocol log.
The bytes read back at %1$s do not match the restored values sent. Some values may have changed. The backup is below; expected and read bytes are in the protocol log.
The write at %1$s could not be completed or its reply could not be read. %2$d earlier address(es) were written; this address may also have changed. Nothing further was written. The backup is below.
The write finished, but the values could not be read back. The result is not verified; some values may have changed. The backup is below.
The write finished, but the byte at %1$s could not be read back. The result is not verified; some values may have changed. The backup is below.
The saved values have been written back. Restart the printer if the model requires it.
Head cleaning \'%1$s\' command has been sent. Wait for the printer to start the routine, then refresh status manually.
Head cleaning job has been sent. Wait for the printer to start the routine, then refresh status manually.
Nozzle check print job has been sent. Wait for the page to print.
The complete backup is only in memory. Closing the app or losing the process will lose it. No bytes have been written yet. Continue only if you accept this risk; copy the backup first.
The backup contains only part of a counter. Restore a complete counter group; nothing was written.
This backup belongs to another printer unit. Nothing was written.
This backup does not identify the original printer unit. Confirm that it came from this printer before restoring.
An operation is in progress. Exiting can interrupt a write and leave partially changed counters. Wait until it finishes if possible.
The printer is still working. Wait until it is idle, then tap Refresh status before the next action.
The printer is still working. Wait until it finishes, then tap Refresh status and retry.
